data.body: [P2] Extend the catalog invariants to cases 21–24, not just the discovery set. The paired-view, invocation schema/topology, execution topology, ordering, and placeholder loops later in this file still stop at `range(1, 21)`, so the new requirements bypass suite-wide contract checks. This also leaves conflicting status semantics (`RETRY` in the invariant table versus `RETRYING` in case 24) untested. Include all 24 cases and adapt the assertions for user spans and count-dependent occurrences, using `RETRYING -> UNSET` as the canonical retry mapping.
